name: Streamline Systems
long_description:
Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. 

Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. 

We’ve secured over $95k in contracted revenue and are supplying navigation modules for the Pentagon’s $1.1bn Drone Dominance Program, as well as precision landing, drone targeting and tracking.
one_liner: Precision navigation for UAVs operating without GPS.

launches.title: Streamline Systems: a replacement for GPS
launches.tagline: A navigation modules that allows drones to operate without GPS
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Charlie and Gabe from **Streamline Systems**. We build precise navigation for drones when GPS fails.

**The problem**\
GPS signals are easy to jam and spoof. When GPS is denied, drones drop out of the sky or fall back to manual piloting. Existing alternatives cost too much for the millions of low-cost drones modern warfare demands.

**Our solution**\
We move positioning into a network you can deploy, so each drone needs only a low-cost module to know where it is. The module drops into existing **ArduPilot, PX4 and INAV** flight controllers. 

**Traction**\
Companies competing in the Pentagon's **$1.1bn Drone Dominance Program** have placed deposits reserving **over $87k worth of modules**. They're building autonomous drones by the million, so they know exactly what navigation needs to cost and how well it needs to work.

The same module can also act as a backup for power grids, telecoms networks and autonomous delivery.

**The team**\
We met at Cambridge. **Gabe** grew up building rocket engines and was on track for a first in his Aerospace and Information Engineering degree when he dropped out to build Streamline full-time. **Charlie** graduated 3rd in his year, grew up building and flying RC planes, served as an RAF reservist and chose Streamline over completing fast-jet pilot selection.

\
**If your drones need to know where they are when GPS fails, please reach out.**
